scripts.setup: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Path backend/venv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; python -m venv backend/venv; ./backend/venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt; ./backend/venv/Scripts/python -m pip install 'opencv-python<4.11' 'numpy<2.0'; npm --prefix frontend install"
scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "netstat -ano | findstr :8000 | ForEach-Object { taskkill /F /PID $_.Split()[-1] }; netstat -ano | findstr :5173 | ForEach-Object { taskkill /F /PID $_.Split()[-1] }"
